assets.name: aisles
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. One Shift inventory navigation background, landscape 1536 by 1024.
Image1 is the approved truck STYLE reference: exact charcoal-black, muted rust and warm cream ink palette, confident broad flat shapes and restrained local paper grain. Image2 is the BUILDING reference. Show another standing human-eye-height view INSIDE that same compact warehouse, now turned right from the cross-aisle and facing its rack ends. Keep the same trusses, suspended practical light fittings, cream industrial walls, durable charcoal steel uprights and muted rust rack beams, scuffed cream concrete and low protective bollards.
The composition contains EXACTLY FOUR clearly separated parallel aisle passages running away from the cross-aisle between FIVE rows of empty warehouse pallet racks. These are aisles between freestanding rack rows, not doorways in a wall. Each of the four mouths must be spacious and unobstructed, with visible empty concrete floor receding to a quiet back wall; each is an obvious individual clickable destination. Arrange the four aisle mouths across most of the image width with their near floor entrances around x190, x560, x950 and x1310, y680. Repeated rack rows separate them, with a little visible rack end depth and structural cross-braces. Camera standing 1.6 metres high, set far enough back in the cross-aisle to see all four entrances fully. Clear aisle-width perspective, shallow natural lens, no fisheye, no top-down or isometric view.
Racks have four storage levels and ordinary industrial proportions. Every shelf is empty. Ceiling occupies upper fifth and generous clear cross-aisle foreground lower quarter. Some irregular ordinary wear and rubbed paint on impact guards; restrained rust accents, strong calm negative space. Far left edge can hint at the cream office wall from image2, but no additional room or different layout.
No people, forklifts, pallets, cartons, merchandise, labels, letters, numerals, signs, arrows, UI or decorative props. No fantasy portals, no perfect new showroom, no wreck or dense grunge. Preserve the exact spare flat print quality of the truck reference, not a photoreal image or intricate engraving. Four aisles, no extra passage at an outer edge.

assets.name: rack
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. One Shift interactive inventory rack background, 1536x1024 landscape.
Image1 is the approved truck STYLE reference. Image2 is the same warehouse's BUILDING reference. Match their charcoal-black steel, muted rust beams, warm cream concrete and walls, broad flat printed forms, sparse edge details and quiet local ink grain.
Main subject: ONE standard warehouse pallet-rack BAY, fully framed, viewed almost straight-on from the aisle by a standing person. This is the FRONT wide face where pallets go, not the narrow cross-braced end. Rack bay has exactly TWO pallet positions side by side across its clear width and exactly FOUR usable storage LEVELS, eight empty locations total. Bottom level is floor storage, plus THREE beam-supported levels above it. Exactly two front outer vertical uprights, NOT a central divider post. Continuous horizontal beams across the bay. The entire bay including both footplates and top is visible, with a modest margin. Nearly frontal orthographic-looking clarity with just a little depth at one side, camera lens corrected verticals, no top-down or isometric view.
Functional geometry is important: rack outer frame roughly x430 to1110 and y85 to895; left/right positions each roughly 290px wide, four tiers roughly 185px high. Three load-bearing rust beam fronts and small wire/deck surfaces should clearly separate the four levels, with shelf surface heights near y300,500,700 and the concrete base at y895. Topmost usable pallet space extends to the upper frame. There must be a completely open rectangular cargo volume ABOVE every shelf so separately composited pallet sprites can fit. Keep the backs of all eight positions quiet neutral dark charcoal, without cross braces through the cargo silhouettes. Side bracing only visible OUTSIDE the clear front cargo aperture. No extra mezzanine, ladders, bars across the slots, center post or shelves within a level.
The aisle floor occupies a low strip of foreground, a calm warehouse wall and very restrained hints of adjacent uprights can appear at the far edges. This is a rack-focused interactive view, with clear empty architecture rather than a decorative warehouse panorama. Functional durable steel with lightly rubbed contact edges and limited paint wear, same existing building.
Absolutely no pallets, cartons, merchandise, people, forklifts, labels, letters, numbers, signage, UI, buttons or watermark. No dense grunge, photoreal textures, gradients, glossy rendering or engraving. Strong simple print quality matching the supplied truck. Count carefully: FOUR levels, TWO positions per level, all EIGHT empty places fully visible.
